subject: SOC2 recertification — evidence window, retention uplift & capacity options
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 recertification — evidence window, retention uplift & capacity options

Hi Marta,

Thanks for the quick call this morning — good to align on the renewal cadence. Per our discussion: Aurelia's SOC 2 recertification is scheduled for Q2; you mentioned wanting an 18-month retention window for audit logs (vs our standard 12 months) and exploring a short-term capacity uplift for a pilot population.

To move forward I can send two packet options: (A) 18-month retention + modest seat uplift (30%) with a 60-day evidence transfer plan, or (B) 18-month retention + 50% capacity uplift + a 3-month credits package for onboarding. Both include the SOC2 evidence checklist we've been using.

Can you confirm which option you want us to price, and whether Aurelia procurement needs an MSA amendment for retention terms? I attached the evidence checklist and a draft retention term matrix to kick off internal approvals.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm option A or B (or send alternate ask)
- We prepare a SOW draft and pricing sheet for procurement
- If needed, we'll route a short-term dedicated capacity queue for the pilot (est. 2–6 weeks to provision)

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-1293

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf, retention_term_matrix.xlsx

From: Marta Gonzalez <marta.gonzalez@aureliahealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:48:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 recertification — evidence window, retention uplift & capacity options

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear summary.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We do need 18 months of log retention for the SOC2 audit.
- Procurement prefers an MSA amendment rather than a brand-new SOW for retention changes.
- For the pilot, we expect roughly a 40% spike in concurrent inference during a 6-week clinical trial window; we need a firm provisioning timeline and a cost estimate for both 30% and 50% uplift scenarios.

Could you include cost delta for the retention change separately from capacity? Procurement also asked for a high-level runbook describing how audit evidence will be exported and the controls around data movement (S3 transfer, encryption in transit, audit trail).

Cc'ing Tim (IT security) who will coordinate with our compliance team on evidence formats.

Best,
Marta
Director of Compliance, Aurelia Health
marta.gonzalez@aureliahealth.com

Lauren / team,

Attached is a pricing package and two clear options per the ask. High level:
Option 1 (Retention-only): 18-month retention addendum, no capacity change. Monthly delta: $4,200.
Option 2 (Retention + Capacity): 18-month retention + 50% dedicated capacity bump for the 6-week pilot. Monthly delta during pilot: $13,500; provisioning lead time: 14 business days for reserved pool, 7 business days for burst-enabled instances.

We included a 3-month onboarding credit (applied to month 1–3) if they commit to the 50% uplift for a minimum 3-month term post-pilot. Also attached a concise SOW amendment template and a short runbook stub.

Attachments: pricing_option_sheet.csv, aurelia_sow_draft.docx

Thanks for reviewing the options. Per your confirmation on today's call, Aurelia would like to proceed with Option 2 (18-month retention + 50% capacity uplift for the 6-week pilot) with the 3-month onboarding credit. Action items and timelines:

1) Ben will send a DocuSign envelope with the MSA amendment and SOW (we will include the retention term matrix and pricing sheet). Expected signing timeline: 3–5 business days.
2) Upon signature, we will queue dedicated capacity provisioning — estimated 14 business days to bring the reserved pool online; burst instances can be enabled in 7 business days if you need an earlier ramp.
3) Naomi to share the runbook and evidence export checklist with Tim by EOD Monday (Dec 21). Link to evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleEvidenceFolder
